## Episode Thesis

The episode is mainly a political panel on how Sweden's government will be formed. Centerpartiet has accepted the Social Democrats' 'total package' (abolishing the karensavdrag sick-pay waiting day, a ban on profits in schools and preschools), and the guests clash over how it would be funded and whether a billionaire or wealth tax is a good idea. No listed Nordic equities are discussed. The only companies named are PostNord as an advertiser, Lovable and a startup transcribed as 'Gora' cited as examples of fast-growing Swedish firms, and AMF's global fund promoted in an advertisement.
